name: Determine the legality of specific actions and items
description: Users asked to determine the legality of specific actions, items, or scenarios in various jurisdictions, such as possessing weapons, transporting goods, or using software. They sought verification of whether particular activities violate data protection, labor, copyright, or criminal laws, often requiring clarification on legal status rather than general legal theory.
